The phase 5 commit 22321b83 left `bun run lint` (oxlint --deny-warnings) failing with 5 errors and 17 warnings, which the g-lint judge recorded as the known set (exit 1). Those 22 findings are fixed, so lint exits 0 with an empty signature. Rule B2 refuses any exit move outside --allow-now-passing, which names tests, not lint findings, so the gate's judge moves by hand to the observation of the bless run /tmp/fast-cert/bless-pr62-song-fixes/live (FAST-CERT --full PASS, freeze held): exit 0, "Found 0 warnings and 0 errors.", no signature. That is a stronger gate: any finding now fails g-lint, and the scoped oxlint job, which allows only g-lint's signature, now allows none.
